WITH school_records AS (
    SELECT f."School Type" AS school_type,
           COALESCE(f."School Type", s.SOCType) AS type_for_matching,
           COALESCE(f."School Name", s.School) AS school_name,
           s.Latitude AS latitude
    FROM schools AS s
    LEFT JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.State = 'CA' AND s.Latitude IS NOT NULL
), middle_schools AS (
    SELECT school_type, school_name, latitude
    FROM school_records
    WHERE type_for_matching IN ('Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)', 'Junior High Schools (Public)')
       OR (' ' || LOWER(school_name) || ' ') GLOB '*[^a-z0-9]middle[^a-z0-9]*'
       OR (' ' || LOWER(school_name) || ' ') GLOB '*[^a-z0-9]intermediate[^a-z0-9]*'
       OR (' ' || LOWER(school_name) || ' ') GLOB '*[^a-z0-9]junior high[^a-z0-9]*'
)
SELECT school_type AS "School Type", school_name AS "School Name", latitude AS Latitude
FROM middle_schools
WHERE latitude = (SELECT MAX(latitude) FROM middle_schools)
ORDER BY school_name, school_type;

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT s.CDSCode,
           s.School AS school_name,
           s.Charter AS charter,
           s.GSserved AS grades_served,
           CAST(f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" AS REAL) / f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS free_meal_rate
    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'
      AND (TRIM(s.GSserved) = '12' OR TRIM(s.GSserved) LIKE '%-12')
      AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
      AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT e.school_name,
       PRINTF('%.4f', e.free_meal_rate) AS free_meal_rate,
       CASE e.charter WHEN 1 THEN 'Yes' WHEN 0 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS charter_school,
       e.grades_served,
       CASE
           WHEN a.AvgScrRead IS NULL OR a.AvgScrMath IS NULL OR a.AvgScrWrite IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
           WHEN a.AvgScrRead + a.AvgScrMath + a.AvgScrWrite < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
           WHEN a.AvgScrRead + a.AvgScrMath + a.AvgScrWrite <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
           ELSE 'Above Average'
       END AS sat_performance_level
FROM eligible AS e
LEFT JOIN satscores AS a ON a.cds = e.CDSCode
WHERE e.free_meal_rate = (SELECT MAX(free_meal_rate) FROM eligible)
ORDER BY e.school_name, e.CDSCode;

WITH RECURSIVE months(month_start) AS (
    SELECT '2010-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date(month_start, '+1 month')
    FROM months
    WHERE month_start < '2010-12-01'
), monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-01', pl.CreationDate) AS month_start,
           COUNT(DISTINCT p.Id) AS post_count
    FROM postLinks AS pl
    JOIN posts AS p ON p.Id = pl.RelatedPostId
    WHERE pl.CreationDate >= '2010-01-01'
      AND pl.CreationDate < '2011-01-01'
      AND p.AnswerCount <= 2
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m-01', pl.CreationDate)
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(mc.post_count, 0)), 2) AS average_monthly_posts
FROM months AS m
LEFT JOIN monthly_counts AS mc ON mc.month_start = m.month_start;
```

WITH patient_labs AS (
    SELECT p.ID, l.FG, TRIM(l."U-PRO") AS protein
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE DATE(p.Birthday) > '1980-01-01'

           CASE WHEN SUBSTR(protein, 1, 2) = '>='

   OR (protein_mg_dl NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*'
       AND protein_mg_dl NOT GLOB '*.*.*'
       AND CAST(protein_mg_dl AS REAL) >= 300);

    SELECT ID, TRIM("U-PRO") AS result
    FROM Laboratory
), urine_concentrations AS (
    SELECT ID,
           CASE
               WHEN SUBSTR(result, 1, 2) = '>=' THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(result, 3))

               ELSE result
           END AS mg_dl
    FROM urine_results
)

)

    FROM urine_concentrations AS u
    WHERE u.ID = p.ID
      AND u.mg_dl GLOB '*[0-9]*'
      AND u.mg_dl NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*'
      AND u.mg_dl NOT GLOB '*.*.*'
      AND CAST(u.mg_dl AS REAL) >= 100
)
ORDER BY p.ID;
